definitions.explanation: A recording of the heart's electrical activity, used to diagnose heart problems. Refers both to the test itself and to the printed/displayed trace.

examples.japanese: {心電図|しんでんず}をとった。
{心電図|しんでんず}に{異常|いじょう}は{見|み}られなかった。
examples.english: No abnormalities were seen on the ECG.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}では{毎年|まいとし}{心電図|しんでんず}を{測定|そくてい}することになっている。
examples.english: At my annual health check, I'm scheduled to have my ECG taken every year.

notes:
Compound of {心|しん} (heart) + {電|でん} (electrical) + {図|ず} (chart). Standard term in medical contexts and health-screening paperwork.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心電図|しんでんず}をとる: to take an ECG
- {心電図|しんでんず}{検査|けんさ}: ECG examination
- {心電図|しんでんず}に{異常|いじょう}がある: to have abnormalities on the ECG
- {心電図|しんでんず}の{波形|はけい}: ECG waveform

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脳波|のうは}: brain waves; EEG — the analogous test for the brain
- {心電計|しんでんけい}: electrocardiograph — the machine that produces the {心電図|しんでんず}
